terms.comment: Our description: unguentum, an ointment (ointment), and sōlāris, of the sun (Ov., Plin., in Lewis & Short). No reference work has a word for sunscreen.

phrases.latin: Prius tē unguentō sōlārī unguam; deinde ad lītus.
phrases.english: First I’ll put sunscreen on you; then to the beach.

phrases.latin: Manē paulisper, dum tibi nāsum et umerōs unguō.
phrases.english: Stay still a moment while I put sunscreen on your nose and shoulders.

phrases.latin: Sōl ārdet: unguentum sōlāre tibi illinam.
phrases.english: The sun’s scorching: I’ll put some sunscreen on you.

sources: Lewis & Short: unguentum · Lewis & Short: solaris · Lewis & Short: ungo · Lewis & Short: illino
